name: NASN100
tagline: Mini-ITX Alder Lake-N NAS motherboard with four 2.5GbE ports
description: NASN100 is a 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX motherboard with Intel N95 / N100 / N200 / i3-N305 options, up to 32GB DDR5, four Intel i226-V 2.5GbE ports, two M.2 NVMe x1 slots and six SATA connections. Its PCIe x1 slot shares resources with the second M.2 slot. This is a motherboard for integration, rather than an enclosed NAS PC.

specs.label: CPU
specs.value: Intel Alder Lake-N N95; Intel Alder Lake-N N100; Intel Alder Lake-N N200; Intel Alder Lake-N i3-N305

specs.label: Memory
specs.value: 1 x DDR5 SO-DIMM; 4800/5200/5600 MHz modules, up to 32GB; operating speed follows the selected CPU/platform

specs.label: Dimensions
specs.value: Mini-ITX, 170 x 170 mm (6.7 x 6.7 in); all solid-state capacitors

specs.label: System
specs.value: Compatible Microsoft@Windows 10/11 64-bit; Compatible Linux; Supports UEFI mode only

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 2 x USB2.0; 1 x USB3.0; 1 x Type-C (USB2.0); 1 x HDMI 2.1; 1 x DP 1.4b; 4 x RJ45 2.5GbE; 1 x 2-in-1 audio jack

specs.label: Internal I/O
specs.value: 1 x FPANEL Pin; 1 x TPM Pin; 1 x USB2.0 Pin; 1 x CPU_FAN 4Pin (temperature control); 1 x SYS_FAN 4Pin (temperature control); 1 x 24+4 ATX Power supply connector; 1 x USB2.0 Socket (Dual USB); 1 x PCIex1 Slot (Shares with the second M.2 slot)

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 2 x M.2 NVMex1(2280); 6 x SATA3.0 6Gb/s; SATA1 is native, SATA2-6 are JMB585 expansion
